script_text: Stop! Libra, the stars are slamming a cosmic door in your face right now. Venus, your ruling planet and gentle Air sign beacon, is in Leo in your 11th House of Friendships, locked in a raw opposition with Pluto in Aquarius in your 5th House of Romance. At the same time, the Sun in Cancer lights your 10th House of Career, sextiling Mars in Virgo in your 12th House of Hidden Work. If you're partnered, watch for power struggles bubbling up from old jealousies. If single, the 11th House Venus pulls you toward a magnetic stranger through group gatherings. Your 10th House Sun suggests a quiet promotion or client win arrives via behind-the-scenes effort, not loud self-promotion. Blessing: an unexpected cheque or refund surfaces from a forgotten account before sunset. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming this week.
